objective: orthogonal Procrustes: W* = argmin_{W^T W = I} ||W X - Y||_F, solved as U V^T from SVD(Y X^T)
status: The paper specifies a learned projection matrix W but does not specify how W is obtained. To implement the pipeline, this repository uses orthogonal Procrustes alignment to instantiate W. This matrix is precomputed here and used frozen.
